page.layout: One page: a decorated book cover (binding), no printed page. Ornamental border around the whole cover. At top centre, a short inked inscription "C A S T". Central tooled panel with a figure scene. Below the panel, a tooled label with two lines of lettering. At the foot, the year in ink. Only the label lines are printed text.
page.notes: The page is the front board of a binding, not a title page. The tooled label lettering is worn and only partly legible; the readings above are uncertain throughout. The inscription "C A S T" at the top and the year "1571" at the foot are handwritten or inked, not printed, so they are left out of the text. The dark ink blot in the centre panel is a stain and is not transcribed. The central panel shows a tooled figure scene under an arch, with no legible text.
